context: This week's 12 teams put up 1595.1 points between them, 132.92 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Somewhere, Bo Nix is still on Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000's bench wondering why -- 24.14 points' worth of wondering, out of 69.74 total left stranded.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Proof records can lie: theMadgician beat ROK Navy's Finest despite the 9th-worst score of the week.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: theMadgician's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: ROK Navy's Finest finished with just 94.62.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: The week's biggest mismatch: Supernova Takeover over VRDNO, 194.78-140.1 (54.68 points).
